image_description: A traditional maypole scene outdoors on a paved surface. A tall, slender wooden pole stands in the center, topped with a floral wreath. Multiple long, colorful ribbons (streamers) extend from the top to the ground where several people, including children and adults in white dresses or casual clothes, are holding them and dancing in a circle. The background features trees and a building with a tiled roof.

The connection points between the dancers' hands and the ribbons are indistinct and blurry. It is difficult to see clear gripping mechanics; the ribbons seem to fade into the hands or float slightly above them.
